<description>
The first commit adds `p2p_1p1c_liveness`, an end-to-end fuzz target for parent and child relay. It
  drives a real PeerManager with real messages and validation, and checks that if an honest peer announces
  the child of an acceptable parent and child, the child reaches the mempool within a bounded time,
  whatever other peers do. Known liveness holes are marked in the target as flags that turn the check off
  once opened, including this one. With that flag turned off, the target finds this bug on master from an
  empty corpus in under an hour on one core; an earlier version found it first
  (https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/36371#issuecomment-5937814761).

  The second commit hands reconsideration over to a remaining announcer when the marked announcement is
  erased, and removes the flag.

Follow-up PR to fill the holes is here: https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/36506
</description>
